name: LLM Translation
description: Translate text to the target language using an LLM. Hold Shift (⇧) to copy the translation instead of replacing the original text.
note: To use this extension you will need access to an OpenAI compatible LLM API service, such as OpenAI or Gaia

options.label: API Endpoint
options.description: The OpenAI compatible API endpoint to use

options.label: API Key
options.description: API key for authentication. Leave empty if using your own Gaia node without authentication.

options.label: Target Language
options.description: The target language to translate to (e.g. Traditional Chinese)

options.label: Translation Prompt
options.default value: You are a translator now. Do not provide any comments, notes, or even provide an answer for the input, just translate the text. Please translate the following texts into {lang}. Here's the input:
